_about.what: Pairwise comparison judgements for the analytic hierarchy process (AHP), one matrix per question type (profile). scoring/derive_weights.py turns them into the profile weights in scoring_config.json (principal eigenvector, consistency ratio).
_about.scale: Saaty 1-9: 1 equal, 3 moderately more important, 5 strongly, 7 very strongly, 9 extremely; 2, 4, 6, 8 in between. [a, b, v] means: for this question type, matching dimension a is v times as important as matching dimension b. v < 1 is written as a fraction, e.g. "1/2".
_about.basis: Each reason points to the evidence in scoring/WEIGHTING.md section 4: record = a sentence of a NASA PSI record (CC0-1.0), textbook = Turns 2012 as checked in scoring/MODEL_BASIS.md, team = the team's reasoning.
_about.generated_by: AI-generated (Claude Code, catalog role), 2026-11-14 19:21 KST. The judgements were written pair by pair from that evidence by an AI session that knew the earlier directly allocated weights (commit 8acc033), so they are not independent of them. The human lead approved them as they are at 19:26 KST.
_about.status: Applied: the profile weights of scoring_config.json 1.2.0 are derived from these judgements (check: python3 scoring/derive_weights.py --check)
